question_en: Which statements are true? 1) Work is a scalar quantity. 2) The work of friction is always positive. 3) In uniform circular motion the centripetal force does no work. 4) $1\ \mathrm{J}=1\ \mathrm{N\cdot m}$.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) Ish skalyar kattalik. 2) Ishqalanish kuchining ishi doim musbat. 3) Aylana bo'ylab tekis harakatda markazga intilma kuch ish bajarmaydi. 4) $1\ \mathrm{J}=1\ \mathrm{N\cdot m}$.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) Работа — скалярная величина. 2) Работа силы трения всегда положительна. 3) При равномерном движении по окружности центростремительная сила работы не совершает. 4) $1\ \mathrm{J}=1\ \mathrm{N\cdot m}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Ishqalanish kuchi ko'chishga qarshi yo'nalgan (α = 180°), uning ishi manfiy — 2-fikr noto'g'ri.
Asos: A = Fs·cos α.

distractors_ru.B: работа силы трения отрицательна, утверждение 3 верно

distractors_en.B: the work of friction is negative and statement 3 is true
distractors_en.D: statement 1 is also true — work is a scalar
distractors_en.E: statement 2 is false — the work of friction is negative

question_en: Which of the following equals the unit of energy, the joule?
question_uz: Quyidagilardan qaysi biri energiya birligi — joulga teng?
question_ru: Какая из перечисленных единиц равна единице энергии — джоулю?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. 1 J = 1 N·m = 1 kg·m/s²·m = 1 kg·m²/s².
Asos: A = Fs, F = ma.

ru: Из определения работы: $$1\ \mathrm{J}=1\ \mathrm{N\cdot m}=1\ \mathrm{kg\cdot\frac{m}{s^2}\cdot m}=1\ \mathrm{kg\cdot m^2/s^2}$$
en: From the definition of work: $$1\ \mathrm{J}=1\ \mathrm{N\cdot m}=1\ \mathrm{kg\cdot\frac{m}{s^2}\cdot m}=1\ \mathrm{kg\cdot m^2/s^2}$$

distractors_en.A: this is the unit of momentum
distractors_en.C: this is the unit of force, the newton
distractors_en.D: this is the unit of stiffness
distractors_en.E: this is the unit of impulse

question_en: A force of $12\ \mathrm{N}$ moves a body $5\ \mathrm{m}$. The angle between the force and the displacement is $60^\circ$. Find the work done by the force ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_uz: Jism $12\ \mathrm{N}$ kuch ta'sirida $5\ \mathrm{m}$ ga ko'chdi. Kuch va ko'chish orasidagi burchak $60^\circ$. Kuchning ishini toping ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_ru: Тело переместилось на $5\ \mathrm{m}$ под действием силы $12\ \mathrm{N}$. Угол между силой и перемещением $60^\circ$. Найдите работу силы ($\mathrm{J}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. A = Fs·cos α = 12·5·0,5 = 30 J.
Asos: ishni kuchning ko'chish yo'nalishiga proyeksiyasi bajaradi.

distractors_en.B: the cosine of the angle was ignored
distractors_en.C: the sine was used instead of the cosine
distractors_en.E: the force was taken as perpendicular to the displacement

question_en: A load is lifted to some height first at constant speed (work $A_1$) and then with an acceleration of $0.2g$ (work $A_2$). Find the relation between $A_1$ and $A_2$.
question_uz: Yuk biror balandlikka avval o'zgarmas tezlik bilan ($A_1$ ish), so'ng $0.2g$ tezlanish bilan ($A_2$ ish) ko'tarildi. $A_1$ va $A_2$ orasidagi munosabatni toping.
question_ru: Груз подняли на некоторую высоту сначала с постоянной скоростью (работа $A_1$), а затем с ускорением $0.2g$ (работа $A_2$). Найдите соотношение между $A_1$ и $A_2$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. A₁ = mgh, A₂ = m(g + 0,2g)h = 1,2mgh, demak A₂ = 1,2A₁.
Asos: tezlanish bilan ko'tarishda A = m(g + a)h.

distractors.C: tezlanish g ga teng deb olingan

distractors_en.B: only the ma part was taken
distractors_en.C: the acceleration was taken as g

question_en: Lifting a $5\ \mathrm{kg}$ body vertically by $2\ \mathrm{m}$ takes $130\ \mathrm{J}$ of work. With what acceleration was the body lifted ($\mathrm{m/s^2}$)?
question_uz: Massasi $5\ \mathrm{kg}$ bo'lgan jismni $2\ \mathrm{m}$ ga tik ko'tarishda $130\ \mathrm{J}$ ish bajarildi. Jism qanday tezlanish bilan ko'tarilgan ($\mathrm{m/s^2}$)?
question_ru: При вертикальном подъёме тела массой $5\ \mathrm{kg}$ на $2\ \mathrm{m}$ совершена работа $130\ \mathrm{J}$. С каким ускорением поднимали тело ($\mathrm{m/s^2}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. F = A/h = 65 N; F − mg = ma ⇒ a = 65/5 − 10 = 3 m/s².
Asos: A = m(g + a)h.

distractors_en.B: the work was divided by mgh

question_en: A body of mass $2\ \mathrm{kg}$ falls freely from rest for $3\ \mathrm{s}$. Find the work done by gravity ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_uz: Massasi $2\ \mathrm{kg}$ bo'lgan jism boshlang'ich tezliksiz $3\ \mathrm{s}$ davomida erkin tushdi. Og'irlik kuchining bajargan ishini toping ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_ru: Тело массой $2\ \mathrm{kg}$ свободно падало без начальной скорости в течение $3\ \mathrm{s}$. Найдите работу силы тяжести ($\mathrm{J}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. h = gt²/2 = 45 m; A = mgh = 2·10·45 = 900 J.
Asos: og'irlik kuchining ishi A = mgh.

question_en: On some stretch the speed of a freely falling $4\ \mathrm{kg}$ body increases from $3\ \mathrm{m/s}$ to $7\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Find the work done by gravity over this stretch ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_uz: Erkin tushayotgan $4\ \mathrm{kg}$ massali jismning tezligi qandaydir yo'lda $3\ \mathrm{m/s}$ dan $7\ \mathrm{m/s}$ gacha ortdi. Og'irlik kuchining shu yo'ldagi ishini toping ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_ru: Скорость свободно падающего тела массой $4\ \mathrm{kg}$ на некотором пути увеличилась с $3\ \mathrm{m/s}$ до $7\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Найдите работу силы тяжести на этом пути ($\mathrm{J}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. A = mv₂²/2 − mv₁²/2 = 2·(49 − 9) = 80 J.
Asos: kinetik energiya haqidagi teorema.

distractors_en.A: this is the change in momentum m(v₂ − v₁)
distractors_en.B: the difference of the speeds was squared
distractors_en.E: only the final kinetic energy was taken

question_en: The work of stretching a spring from $0$ to $\Delta x$ is $A_1$, and from $2\Delta x$ to $3\Delta x$ it is $A_2$. Find the ratio $A_2/A_1$.
question_uz: Prujinani $0$ dan $\Delta x$ gacha cho'zish ishi $A_1$, $2\Delta x$ dan $3\Delta x$ gacha cho'zish ishi $A_2$. $A_2/A_1$ nisbatni toping.
question_ru: Работа растяжения пружины от $0$ до $\Delta x$ равна $A_1$, от $2\Delta x$ до $3\Delta x$ — $A_2$. Найдите отношение $A_2/A_1$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. A₁ = kΔx²/2, A₂ = k(9Δx² − 4Δx²)/2 = 5kΔx²/2, demak A₂/A₁ = 5.
Asos: A = k(x₂² − x₁²)/2.

uz: Ishlar: $$A_1=\frac{k\Delta x^2}{2},\qquad A_2=\frac{k(9\Delta x^2-4\Delta x^2)}{2}=\frac{5k\Delta x^2}{2}$$
ru: Работы: $$A_1=\frac{k\Delta x^2}{2},\qquad A_2=\frac{k(9\Delta x^2-4\Delta x^2)}{2}=\frac{5k\Delta x^2}{2}$$
en: The works: $$A_1=\frac{k\Delta x^2}{2},\qquad A_2=\frac{k(9\Delta x^2-4\Delta x^2)}{2}=\frac{5k\Delta x^2}{2}$$

distractors.D: teng cho'zilishlarda ish teng deb olingan

distractors_ru.D: для равных растяжений работа принята одинаковой

distractors_en.B: the full work up to 3Δx was taken
distractors_en.C: the work was taken as proportional to the deformation
distractors_en.D: equal stretches were assumed to need equal work
distractors_en.E: only the work up to 2Δx was taken

question_en: The mass of a plane is $20$ times smaller than that of a truck, and its speed is $10$ times greater. How many times greater is the plane's kinetic energy than the truck's?
question_uz: Samolyotning massasi yuk mashinasining massasidan $20$ marta kichik, tezligi esa $10$ marta katta. Samolyotning kinetik energiyasi yuk mashinasinikidan necha marta katta?
question_ru: Масса самолёта в $20$ раз меньше массы грузовика, а скорость в $10$ раз больше. Во сколько раз кинетическая энергия самолёта больше, чем у грузовика?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Eₖ ∝ mv²: (1/20)·10² = 100/20 = 5.
Asos: Eₖ = mv²/2.

distractors_ru.D: умножено на отношение масс вместо деления

distractors_en.B: the mass and speed ratios were swapped
distractors_en.C: the difference in mass was ignored
distractors_en.D: multiplied by the mass ratio instead of dividing

question_en: A body of mass $4\ \mathrm{kg}$ has a momentum of $10\ \mathrm{kg\cdot m/s}$. Find its kinetic energy ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_uz: Massasi $4\ \mathrm{kg}$ bo'lgan jismning impulsi $10\ \mathrm{kg\cdot m/s}$. Uning kinetik energiyasini toping ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_ru: Импульс тела массой $4\ \mathrm{kg}$ равен $10\ \mathrm{kg\cdot m/s}$. Найдите его кинетическую энергию ($\mathrm{J}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Eₖ = p²/2m = 100/8 = 12,5 J (yoki v = 2,5 m/s, Eₖ = 4·2,5²/2).
Asos: Eₖ = p²/(2m).

distractors_en.C: this is the speed v = p/m

question_en: By what factor must a body's speed increase for its kinetic energy to increase by a factor of $1.44$?
question_uz: Jismning kinetik energiyasi $1.44$ marta ortishi uchun uning tezligi necha marta ortishi kerak?
question_ru: Во сколько раз должна увеличиться скорость тела, чтобы его кинетическая энергия увеличилась в $1.44$ раза?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Eₖ ∝ v², demak v₂/v₁ = √1,44 = 1,2 (tezlik 20 foizga ortadi).
Asos: Eₖ = mv²/2.

distractors_en.A: the energy was taken as proportional to the speed

question_en: A body of mass $200\ \mathrm{g}$ is thrown vertically upwards at $25\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Find its potential energy relative to the launch point after $2\ \mathrm{s}$ ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_uz: Massasi $200\ \mathrm{g}$ bo'lgan jism $25\ \mathrm{m/s}$ tezlik bilan yuqoriga tik otildi. $2\ \mathrm{s}$ dan keyin jismning otilish nuqtasiga nisbatan potensial energiyasini toping ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_ru: Тело массой $200\ \mathrm{g}$ брошено вертикально вверх со скоростью $25\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Найдите потенциальную энергию тела относительно точки бросания через $2\ \mathrm{s}$ ($\mathrm{J}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. h = v₀t − gt²/2 = 50 − 20 = 30 m; Eₚ = mgh = 0,2·10·30 = 60 J.
Asos: Eₚ = mgh.

distractors_en.A: gt²/2 was not subtracted: h = v₀t
distractors_en.D: this is the energy at the maximum height

question_en: A plane flies at a height of $8\ \mathrm{km}$ at a constant speed of $720\ \mathrm{km/h}$. How many times greater is its potential energy relative to the Earth than its kinetic energy?
question_uz: $8\ \mathrm{km}$ balandlikda $720\ \mathrm{km/h}$ o'zgarmas tezlik bilan uchayotgan samolyotning Yerga nisbatan potensial energiyasi kinetik energiyasidan necha marta katta?
question_ru: Во сколько раз потенциальная энергия самолёта относительно Земли, летящего на высоте $8\ \mathrm{km}$ с постоянной скоростью $720\ \mathrm{km/h}$, больше его кинетической энергии?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. v = 200 m/s; Eₚ/Eₖ = 2gh/v² = 2·10·8000/40000 = 4.
Asos: Eₚ = mgh, Eₖ = mv²/2.

distractors.B: kinetik energiyada 2 ga bo'lish tushib qolgan

distractors_ru.B: в кинетической энергии пропущено деление на 2

distractors_en.B: the division by 2 in the kinetic energy was dropped
distractors_en.D: the speed was left in km/h
distractors_en.E: the height was left in km

question_en: A force of $50\ \mathrm{N}$ holds a spring of stiffness $250\ \mathrm{N/m}$ stretched. Find the potential energy of the spring ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_uz: Bikrligi $250\ \mathrm{N/m}$ bo'lgan prujinaga $50\ \mathrm{N}$ kuch ta'sir qilib, uni cho'zib turibdi. Prujinaning potensial energiyasini toping ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_ru: На пружину жёсткостью $250\ \mathrm{N/m}$ действует сила $50\ \mathrm{N}$, удерживая её растянутой. Найдите потенциальную энергию пружины ($\mathrm{J}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. x = F/k = 0,2 m; Eₚ = kx²/2 = F²/2k = 2500/500 = 5 J.
Asos: Eₚ = kx²/2, F = kx.

distractors_en.A: this is the extension x = F/k

question_en: Two springs of stiffness $k_1=0.4\ \mathrm{kN/m}$ and $k_2=1.2\ \mathrm{kN/m}$ are connected in series and stretched. Find the ratio $E_1/E_2$ of their potential energies.
question_uz: Bikrliklari $k_1=0.4\ \mathrm{kN/m}$ va $k_2=1.2\ \mathrm{kN/m}$ bo'lgan ikkita prujina ketma-ket ulanib, cho'zildi. Prujinalar potensial energiyalarining nisbati $E_1/E_2$ ni toping.
question_ru: Две пружины жёсткостью $k_1=0.4\ \mathrm{kN/m}$ и $k_2=1.2\ \mathrm{kN/m}$ соединены последовательно и растянуты. Найдите отношение потенциальных энергий пружин $E_1/E_2$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Kuch bir xil, Eₚ = F²/2k, demak E₁/E₂ = k₂/k₁ = 3 — yumshoq prujinada energiya ko'p.
Asos: ketma-ket ulanganda F₁ = F₂.

en: In series the force is the same: $$F_1=F_2=F$$

rules.en: In series the force is the same

distractors_en.A: the extensions were taken as equal
distractors_en.C: the energies were taken as equal
